title: A2A (Agent2Agent protocol): how agents hand tasks to other agents, and where you can stop them
summary: The documented controls and commands are supported, including the package-blocking path on the updated Microsoft page. Two minor qualifications remain: connected agents must be acquired for their users, and Microsoft's Foundry setup guide gives a stricter consent role than the general Entra guide.
